_comment: Project-wide Claude Code settings for the SpecRoute repository itself. Tracked. Per-user overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). This repo dogfoods runtimes/.claude/settings.template.json - keep the two structurally aligned.
_comment_hooks_source: The "hooks" key below is generated from .claude/hooks/hooks.json by tools/sync-hooks-to-settings.sh. Edit hooks.json (it carries the annotations), then run the script. Do not hand-edit "hooks" here - the next sync overwrites it. This settings file is what the CLI reads; hooks.json alone would never load.

permissions._comment: Permissions tighten or relax what Claude Code can do without prompting. Personal additions belong in settings.local.json, not here.

_env_comment: Environment variables passed to tools. Do NOT put secrets here - they belong in .env (gitignored) or in your shell profile.
_mcp_comment: The Claude Code CLI reads MCP servers from .mcp.json at the repo root (project scope) or ~/.claude.json (user scope). See runtimes/mcp/servers.yaml for the cross-vendor source of truth.
